<!-- pr-reviewer: 2f0f28028f06625d4c17b93ec3211e2d980dac0e -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one small test gap; the code itself looks right). Reviewed the commit beyond 18802064 (stacked on #576/#566).

### What looks good
- One law: locate's sampled test and its by-name messages moved into `fixture_clash.rs`; `fixture_locate::interpenetration`/`stock_interpenetration` and the new `MoveModel`/`MoveFixture` checks all call `fixture_clash::clash`. Locate wording unchanged (its suites pass).
- Advisory only: `MoveModel::build`/`MoveFixture::new` return `Ok` with `warning()`; `apply`/`invert` stay pure writes, so undo/redo are untouched (`undo_of_a_warned_move_puts_part_and_stock_back` restores part and stock, redo replays). `locating` variants skip the check, so no double warning.
- No tangent false positive: samples count only `PENETRATION_MM` (0.05) deep; `a_clear_move_warns_nothing` and the stock-only test (part resting on the floor face) pin this.
- Moved stock is judged through `moved_stock`, which honours the `reshape` (regrown box), and only against the setup that owns it. No-fixture setups skip geometry. No unwrap/expect/panic added; open mesh logged and judged clear.
- Provenance, decision record, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #582` present; no snapshot PNGs or build.rs/scripts/.github/deps touched.

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, clean merge)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| move_interpenetration | 7 passed |
| move_model_stock / commands_undo | 4 / 32 passed |
| fixture_locate / fixture_locate_stock | 11 / 3 passed |
| fixtures / fixture_ux / setup_align | 14 / 9 / 9 passed |
| project_roundtrip / mcp_setup | 69 / 4 passed |
| app lib | 105 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 382 passed, 1 failed (`headless_run_succeeds`: "No suitable graphics adapter found", environmental on this Mac) |
| clippy app + ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
1. Add the test the issue asks for: a **turn that sinks the regrown stock into a fixture** is flagged. Today `a_turn_that_swings_the_part_into_the_jaw_warns_by_name` (`crates/app/tests/move_interpenetration.rs`) has no stock, and the stock-only test is a pure translation, so the turn + `reshape` path through `moved_stock` -> `after_part_move` is unpinned. Use `document(true, Some(..))`, turn the part so the part itself clears the jaw but the refitted stock enters it, and assert `the stock '<name>' would sink into the fixture`.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `fixture_clash.rs:after_part_move`: `let Some(raw) = &tris else { return None };` drops warnings already gathered from earlier setups if facets are missing; `continue`/`break` keeping `warnings` would be tidier (cannot really happen since the entity was found).
- `join_warnings` now dedups via `fixture_clash::join`; harmless.
- The check runs on every `MoveModel::new`, i.e. each UI nudge, on up to 20k samples per body per fixture; fine for now, worth watching on large vises.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: cfa2fdaa4e7b24bd34abb9fe62d5debbe329da4a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Re-review of the delta since 2f0f2802; the one earlier blocker is resolved.

**What looks good**
- `a_turn_whose_regrown_square_stock_sinks_into_the_jaw_warns_for_the_stock` really exercises turn + reshape: it asserts the warning text for the stock (and not the part), then executes the command and checks the stock was regrown to 16 x 26, not carried. I mutated `MoveModel::moved_stock` to ignore the reshape mesh (read the pre-turn facets instead): the new test fails and the other 7 pass. Mutation reverted; worktree was clean afterwards.
- `fixture_clash::after_part_move` no longer returns `None` for a part without facets: earlier setups' warnings stand and the stock is still judged. Correct, and no unwrap/index risk added.
- Per-nudge cost noted in `docs/decisions/582-move-interpenetration.md`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| move_interpenetration | 8 passed |
| move_model_stock | 4 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| fixture_locate | 11 passed |
| fixture_locate_stock | 3 passed |
| camcraft-app --lib | 105 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

UI suites not run (known environmental "No suitable graphics adapter found").

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The delta touches no build.rs, scripts, .github or dependencies, and no snapshot PNGs.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
